narrative.title: The Grid-Van Delivery Grid
narrative.scenario: A courier drone flies over a city laid out as an m x n grid of blocks, launching at the northwest depot and landing at the southeast customer. Air-traffic rules allow only eastward and southward movement — no backtracking. Logistics needs to know how many distinct legal flight plans exist so it can spread fleet traffic across them.
narrative.inputFormat: Two integers m (rows) and n (columns) describing the grid.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of distinct down/right-only paths from the top-left to the bottom-right cell.
constraints: the answer fits in a 32-bit signed integer

testCases.explanation: Every path is a sequence of 2 downs and 6 rights; the cell DP accumulates to 28.
Two downs interleaved with one right: DDR, DRD, RDD.

hintLevels: Level 1: A cell can only be entered from above or from the left, so its route count is the sum of theirs.
Level 2: paths[i][j] = paths[i-1][j] + paths[i][j-1], with the entire top row and left column filled with 1.
Level 3: One rolling row suffices — fold each new row into the previous one.
